scope: Own-source selector numbering, argument mutation, diagnostics and registry/preconversion identity. All primary names/numbers, supported nested/deep labels, absent future names, invalid IDs and partial mapping are explicit frozen cases. Registry callback bodies are refusing stubs. Does not establish property storage or getter/setter runtime acceptance. Own first-letter search before4171 and binary search from4171 determine lookup results, including unreachable names in native unsorted tables. Added argument/storage refusals are independent safety controls.
